reference: Fixed documented contracts. JSON and Bash byte spans are hand-computed from literal ASCII inputs and curated query classes; ANSI bytes follow the documented palette and capture precedence. Candidate captures and the shared ts renderer are not oracles.
coverage: Exact JSON key/string/escape byte spans and ANSI bytes.
Nested Bash function/string/variable/comment spans and ANSI bytes.
Relative file preservation, empty input, uncaptured whitespace and argument/input errors.
exclusions: No exhaustive grammar/query or grapheme/locale qualification is claimed; fixed spans qualify only these examples.

cases.purpose: Bash type metadata must identify hl as a builtin, matching the loadable contract.
Bash help must expose the documented invocation and the resolved-span description for -S.
cases.script: h=$(help hl); [[ $h == *'hl -L LANG [-S] [FILE]'* && $h == *'resolved nonoverlapping spans'* ]]; printf '%s\n' 'help synopsis and span description present'
cases.stdout: help synopsis and span description present

cases.purpose: Hand-computed key and nested escape precedence byte ranges.
Exact SGR framing; uncaptured punctuation is unchanged.
Hand-computed ASCII byte spans for function, command, quoted string, expansion and comment.
cases.stdout:
0-1 36 function
6-10 36 function
11-14 32 string
14-16 37 variable
16-19 32 string
20-23 90 comment

cases.purpose: Exact ANSI bytes for nested Bash captures without escape stripping.
Whitespace remains unchanged; empty render/span output is empty; private source is preserved.
cases.script: printf '[ ]\n' > source; hl -L json source; [[ $(<source) == '[ ]' ]]; : > empty; hl -L json < empty; hl -L json -S < empty
